title: Questions that must be answered before a decision is reasonable
reading: each row states what would answer the question, what we already have, what we do not have, and the action that would obtain it. No row contains a guess at the answer.

rows.question: Can a price we are allowed to use be obtained at all?
rows.information_needed: The price policy decision: a publisher plus a capture time.
rows.we_have: 12,573 stored price rows, 6,345 of them carrying an official nfl.com source key.
rows.we_do_not_have: Any officially published number with a known capture time. None exists in the store.
rows.how_to_obtain: One licensed feed or one operator price history with timestamps.

rows.question: How large is the 2026 graded sample, exactly?
rows.information_needed: Arithmetic between the results corpus and official standings.
rows.we_have: 150 games, weeks 1-10; standings imply 150.0; points 6923 equal sum(PF) 6923.
rows.we_do_not_have: Nothing for weeks 1-10; weeks 11+ are unplayed.
rows.how_to_obtain: The season to finish, then a re-read of every week page.

rows.question: Is the moneyline skill real or is it one hot week?
rows.information_needed: A week-cluster interval, a permutation null, and leave-one-week-out folds.
rows.we_have: M2: skill +0.1509, 90% bound [+0.0795, +0.2143], Holm p 0.0085; dropping the best week leaves +0.1109; 0 of 2000 label shuffles match or beat it.
rows.we_do_not_have: Out-of-season confirmation. Ten weeks of one season is a short claim.
rows.how_to_obtain: A full 18-week 2026 block, and a second season.

rows.question: Why does the side (margin) market show no skill while the moneyline does?
rows.information_needed: Two proper scores on the same forecasts: CRPS on margin, Brier on the win.
rows.we_have: Margin CRPS skill is near zero for every model; the win Brier skill is positive. A rating that ranks teams but mis-estimates the spread size would do this.
rows.we_do_not_have: A model whose sigma is fitted, not inherited from in-sample residuals.
rows.how_to_obtain: Fit the dispersion on the validation block and re-score the margin market.

rows.question: Why does the total show no skill?
rows.information_needed: The same interval machinery applied to the total market.
rows.we_have: Benchmark-relative total skill +0.0320, Holm-adjusted p 1.0000 for every model. Club total persistence between consecutive games is 0.0718 with n 268.
rows.we_do_not_have: A total model with information beyond past club totals.
rows.how_to_obtain: A published pace/plays/efficiency input read from an official source.

rows.question: Does availability change outcomes at all, and by how much?
rows.information_needed: An ablation: identical models with and without verified availability features.
rows.we_have: Nothing usable: 0 snap counts, 0 inactive lists, 1 image-only club chart.
rows.we_do_not_have: Snap counts and inactive lists for the graded games.
rows.how_to_obtain: Capture both, then run the ablation with chronological holdouts.

rows.question: How deep is the replacement when a starter is out?
rows.information_needed: Chart rank of the out player and of his replacement.
rows.we_have: 10 documented replacements, all 10 with a rank difference.
rows.we_do_not_have: A rank for every replacement, and a chart capture at the time of the game.
rows.how_to_obtain: Daily chart captures joined to roster events.

rows.question: Are the depth charts current?
rows.information_needed: A join against the official November 2026 reserve list.
rows.we_do_not_have: A re-capture of the flagged clubs after their roster moves.
rows.how_to_obtain: One capture per club per day with a retained hash.

rows.question: Which club's chart cannot be read at all?
rows.we_have: 1 of 32 clubs are image-only; 705 slots transcribed from the other 31.
rows.we_do_not_have: A structured Houston chart, or an official snap-count source for all 32.
rows.how_to_obtain: The club's own structured feed, or the snap-count route.

rows.question: What does a blank game status mean?
rows.information_needed: The official page's own vocabulary across two dated reads.
rows.we_have: Of 253 rows, 16 carry a designation (6.32%). Blank is published as blank.
rows.we_do_not_have: Inactive lists to join against the blanks.
rows.how_to_obtain: Capture the inactive list at kickoff for each game.

rows.question: Is the injury signal a surprise or a level?
rows.information_needed: Two dated reads of the same report week, joined player by player.
rows.we_have: 241 players appear in both reads; 1 differs.
rows.we_do_not_have: More than one week of two-read pairs.
rows.how_to_obtain: Daily captures from Wednesday to kickoff, every week.

rows.question: Do two sessions reading the same official page agree?
rows.information_needed: A join on (club, player) between two independently written parsers.
rows.we_have: 241 of 241 joined rows identical on position and game status; practice agrees on 240.
rows.we_do_not_have: Nothing: this is the strongest corroboration available without a second publisher.
rows.how_to_obtain: Nothing further; the limit is stated.

rows.question: Is our own line close to the official posted line?
rows.information_needed: Residual = model fair line minus the official posted line, per market.
rows.we_have: 450 residual rows, 450 with an official line.
rows.we_do_not_have: A capture time on the posted line, so the residual can be dated against kickoff.

rows.question: Can a parlay or prop combo be ranked yet?
rows.information_needed: A directly validated joint probability plus the operator's void/push rules.
rows.we_have: All three combo divisions are closed; 0 joint prices exist.
rows.we_do_not_have: One joint price from an official or licensed source.

rows.question: Which of the three markets should be published first?
rows.information_needed: The registered order and whether the ranking supports it.
rows.we_have: Registered order: side, total, moneyline. Measured: only the moneyline clears a Holm-adjusted threshold; the side and total do not.
rows.we_do_not_have: Whether a side-skill model exists at all.
rows.how_to_obtain: Diagnose the margin dispersion (Q04) before reordering.

rows.question: Is the repository's own data layer lawful to republish?
rows.information_needed: A rights decision for the raw rows and for any third-party archive.
rows.we_have: None recorded. Raw rows sit in a public repository.
rows.we_do_not_have: A recorded decision, or a move of raw rows to a private store.
rows.how_to_obtain: Read the terms of every source before publishing row-level data.

rows.question: Has any number here been read live from an official page today?
rows.information_needed: An egress test before the build.
rows.we_have: No: the sandbox has no HTTPS route to nfl.com. Every number is a stored capture with its own date, or a computation over one.
rows.we_do_not_have: Nothing; this is a disclosure, not a defect.
rows.how_to_obtain: A session with egress re-reads the sources and diffs them.
